description: S50 T1 (RM2), the wire-side twin of the no-actor rule: roadmap.add params carry "actor" — refused by KEY before the lenient decode (decodeParams ignores unknown keys, so the refusal lives here or nowhere; the backup.run precedent BK13 and the environment plane's identity vocabulary). The actor is stamped by the door that holds the connection and never named by the caller — a param that carried one would let anyone forge the audit identity of the write, which is precisely what the roadmap_change table exists to make impossible. "actorKind" and "who" carry the same refusal on every roadmap write (add, cancel, estimate, priority, ideate, plan, materialize).

error.message: invalid params: roadmap.add refuses the param "actor" — the actor is stamped from the connection, never carried in params (RM2)
